body:
#### `BluetoothError.NOT_CONNECTED(msg: string): BluetoothError`

Thrown by the `Peripheral` methods that talk to the device when the peripheral is not connected: before `'connect'`, and once the link is gone. The error message reads `NOT_CONNECTED: Peripheral is not connected`. Added in v0.11.6. As of v0.11.6, `lib/errors.d.ts` does not declare this factory, although `lib/errors.js` defines it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `msg` | `string` | — | A human-readable error message. |

#### `CentralEventMap`

```ts
interface CentralEventMap {
  stateChange: [state: BluetoothState]
  discover: [peripheral: Peripheral]
  connect: [peripheral: Peripheral]
  disconnect: [peripheral: Peripheral | null]
  error: [error: BluetoothError]
}
```

`connect` carries the connected `Peripheral`. `disconnect` carries the disconnected `Peripheral`, or `null` if it was not tracked as connected; when the disconnect carried an error, `error` is emitted instead. The event map types are declared in the package's type files and are not re-exported from the package root.

#### `PeripheralEventMap`

```ts
interface PeripheralEventMap {
  servicesDiscover: [services: Service[]]
  characteristicsDiscover: [service: Service | null, characteristics: Characteristic[]]
  read: [characteristic: Characteristic | null, data: Uint8Array]
  write: [characteristic: Characteristic | null]
  notify: [characteristic: Characteristic | null, data: Uint8Array]
  notifyState: [characteristic: Characteristic | null, isNotifying: boolean]
  channelOpen: [channel: L2CAPChannel]
  mtuChanged: [mtu: number]
  disconnect: []
  error: [error: BluetoothError]
}
```

`disconnect` is emitted when the peripheral has disconnected without error. As of v0.9.2, `read`, `write`, `notify`, and `notifyState` are dropped, rather than emitted with `null`, when the characteristic is not one this peripheral has discovered.

#### `ServerEventMap`

```ts
interface ServerEventMap {
  stateChange: [state: BluetoothState]
  serviceAdd: [uuid: string]
  channelPublish: [psm: number]
  channelOpen: [channel: L2CAPChannel]
  readRequest: [request: ReadRequest]
  writeRequest: [requests: WriteRequest[]]
  subscribe: [deviceAddress: string, characteristicUuid: string]
  unsubscribe: [deviceAddress: string, characteristicUuid: string]
  connecting: [deviceAddress: string]
  connected: [deviceAddress: string]
  disconnecting: [deviceAddress: string]
  disconnected: [deviceAddress: string]
  notifySent: [deviceAddress: string, status: number]
  error: [error: BluetoothError]
}
```

`subscribe` and `unsubscribe` carry the address of the connected device and the UUID of the characteristic. On Apple platforms they carry a native central handle instead.
